text_block_list.text:
While on the way back from an outing,
Hishi
Amazon abruptly stops in her
tracks and turns to
me with a stern look.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's time to settle things, Teach. Come
on, follow
my lead!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You'll find out soon enough!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, we're here! Ahhh... the air is so
crisp.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Cause we can have an all-out,
no-holds-barred
battle out here!
choice_data_list: 渓流沿いのキャンプ場……

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now brace yourself, Teach! It's time for
our
one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I've been tryin' to figure out what the
most
important thing about cooking is
for ages...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And I've finally found my answer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna use that all-important thing
while
cooking and let you try the dish
once I'm done!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And if you can figure out what the secret
is, it's
your win!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Great! I'm gonna have to make the best
dish I
can, or else all my feelings and
hard work'll go to
waste!
choice_data_list: そういうことなら、受けて立つ！
そういうことなら、受けて立つよ！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait right here. I'm gonna go hunt and
forage the
best ingredients I can and
cook my way to
victory!

Hishi Amazon gathers a bounty of fresh
fish and
veggies from our surroundings,
and cooks them
skillfully on a camping
stove.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's just about ready! With my
special
super-powered stove...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll roast this fish in a flash! Grraaah!
Sizzle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Grub's up! I humbly name this
spread
"Camp Barbecue So Good, It'd
Move Even a
Monster to Tears"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Eat up and savor it all, Teach! And once
you're
done, go ahead and try to guess
the answer I've
finally found!

I eat through a hearty plate of grilled
fish and
wild vegetables cooked to
perfection...
Everything tastes amazing.

After tasting the dish, I conclude that
the
all-important thing Hishi Amazon
used in her
cooking must be...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...! Now what makes you say that?

I tell her how I was able to sense the
competitive
spirit she used to dominate
even the strongest
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I knew you would get it right, Teach.
Yup, I came
to the conclusion that this
spirit of mine's the
most important thing
about cooking.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, it took some experimenting.
There's a lot of
things you need in order
to cook, like knowledge,
technique, and
heart...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But none of those things are where my
true roots
are. See, my roots come from
my fiery Kentucky
spirit!
Woosh! Crackle, crackle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! That meat was the best of the
best—but
I'm better, and I grilled it real
good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I wanted you to feel that thrill—to tackle
a huge
plate with all your heart, and
come out on top.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I know that to most people, the fires of
my dad's
grill may not have looked like
anything special...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But I can feel them burning in me,
roaring higher
and higher!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And now, I think I finally get why my
dad told me
why I had to figure out the
answer myself.

Hishi Amazon has found an answer only
she could
have come up with.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, still, I didn't think you'd guess the
right
answer immediately. What're the
chances?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
How were you even able to see through
me that
easily?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
choice_data_list: 俺は、ヒシアマゾンのトレーナーだから
私は、ヒシアマゾンのトレーナーだから

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! Okay, you win, you win! I've lost
in more
ways than one!
Splash!

Hishi Amazon sprints towards the stream
and
dives in it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I dunno, just needed to cool off
a bit. I
was startin' to feel really hot.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll just swim around for a bit as
punishment for
losing our battle! Now
stop staring at me!

Hishi Amazon dives under the water in
order to
conceal her face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. What makes you say that?

Hishi Amazon has seasoned everything
to my
liking.

In other words, the answer she came up
with must
be to prioritize the tastes and
preferences of the
person she's serving.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Too bad, 'cause you're wrong! And
that makes
me the winner, Teach!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, of course I made sure to season

everything well. Let me have a quick
bite to see
what you mean...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Munch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, all this stuff is perfectly tailored to your tastes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: The heck! What if you're right? But I'm the one that made all this...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! All right, fine! It looks like it's
my loss!
choice_data_list: ヒシアマゾン、破れたり！

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I guess I was subconsciously being
influenced by
you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But don't let this one victory get to your
head!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Our next battle will be different! I
definitely won't
lose to you again!

I tell her I wouldn't have it any other
way.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You don't?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I guess victory goes to me! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about, Teach? I
didn't think
you'd be able to give me an
answer that easily.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'm happy that you were so
honest with
me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now we'll have even more opportunities
to duke
it out together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! While we're at it, why don't we
start our
next competition?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's dive straight into that stream and
see who
can catch the most fish with
their bare hands!

I have a fun time competing against
Hishi
Amazon.
